content:
I'm excited to announce the launch of the Mathlib phrasebook. The goal of the phrasebook is to answer questions of the form "How do I say … using Mathlib?", where "…" can vary from "vector space" to "quasi-ergodic map". In other words, think of this project as a dictionary to accompany textbooks like Mathematics in Lean and the practical complement to reference works like the API docs. How-to guides in this form have been often requested, and it is great to finally have a place to put and find them. I am very grateful to the first people who have already contributed a phrasebook entry.

We are looking for contributions! Pick your favourite mathematical subject and write a little one-page guide to the main concepts. (But please coordinate with each other in the discussion thread to make sure there is no double work.) Oliver wrote down a few topic suggestions to help you get started.
